name: Cloudflare Agent Week
description: A cloud-first radar for Cloudflare's agent runtime, browser, Computer, Workers, MCP, and developer-platform launches, with optional signed-in social discovery.
author: Driftglass contributors

args.query: Cloudflare (Computer OR Kitesurf OR Agents SDK OR Workers)

missions.name: Cloudflare agent adoption
missions.question: Which Cloudflare agent launch creates a practical workflow worth adopting now, and what evidence would change that judgment?

views.name: Agent runtime
views.query: Cloudflare Computer Kitesurf Agents SDK Workflows MCP

entities.name: Cloudflare Computer
entities.description: Durable agent workspace with a shared filesystem and optional execution backends.

entities.name: Kitesurf
entities.description: Agent-first browser execution on Cloudflare Workers.

questions.title: Which Agent Week capabilities are production-ready versus best kept as bounded experiments?
Which architecture preserves the strongest agent capabilities within the Free or cheap Workers envelope?

relations.rationale: Both participate in persistent Cloudflare agent applications.
Kitesurf provides a browser tool for Cloudflare-hosted agents.

claims.title: Kitesurf is the preferred lightweight public-page renderer
claims.summary: Use Kitesurf before Chromium when the page does not require a persistent signed-in browser session.

expectations.title: Agent Week preview APIs will continue to change before broad production maturity
expectations.summary: Track release notes and implementation activity before locking deep integrations.

skill.name: Cloudflare agent architecture
skill.description: Evaluate Cloudflare agent launches as an integrated architecture rather than isolated announcements.
skill.instructions: Separate generally available infrastructure, beta capability, and preview runtime. Prefer the smallest architecture that preserves the new capability. Compare direct HTTP, Kitesurf, Chromium, Computer filesystem, isolate execution, Workflows, and external reasoning surfaces by actual job-to-be-done.

researchPlaybooks.name: Cloudflare architecture decision
researchPlaybooks.trigger: A new Cloudflare runtime changes an existing design choice.
researchPlaybooks.instructions: Compare the new path with the current Driftglass component. Preserve proven state, provenance, and retry boundaries unless the new capability subsumes them. State migration cost and rollback.

providerHints.chatgpt: Use Deep Research for current launch documentation and MCP for the private Driftglass history.
providerHints.claude: Use the Mission Computer files when reviewing code or architecture decisions.
providerHints.grok: Use social search for emerging implementation reports, but verify release facts against Cloudflare and repositories.

outputContract: recommend adopt, experiment, watch, or ignore

routines.name: Cloudflare agent-platform monitor
routines.description: Refresh official releases, live repository activity, packages, and posts before updating the standing adoption Mission.

routines.name: Challenge the Cloudflare architecture thesis
routines.description: Prepare an adversarial context and Deep Research handoff without running a built-in model.

args.objective: Challenge the current thesis that Cloudflare is the best substrate for this personal intelligence system. Identify regressions, alternatives, and a decisive next test.
